title: Build a BambooHR alternative with Claude: free employee onboarding spec, 20/20 checks passed
description:
Claude built a BambooHR alternative from one Markdown spec: all 20 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 109 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 44 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for an employee onboarding checklist for teams of 5 to 150 people and had it build the tool in four phases: templates, people and sign-in; onboardings and tasks; the new hire's view; and the daily job, digests and the CSV export. The core rule is due dates: every task is due a set number of days before or after the start date, a due date that lands on a weekend moves to the Friday before, and when the start date moves, every open task moves with it. The gaps included private 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins that any role could own, nothing stopping the people team from deactivating themselves, and task titles starting with = that could run as formulas in the CSV export. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when BambooHR is still the better buy.

BambooHR prices: for 25 employees or fewer, a flat $250 a month for Core, $425 for Pro and $650 for Elite; above 25 employees, from $10.25 per employee per month for Core, $17.50 for Pro and $25 for Elite, with automatic volume discounts. Onboarding is one part of its HR system (bamboohr.com/pricing, October 2026).
